{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
{{Quote|How can one who doesn't believe in his own powers stand against the power of another? It is impossible.|[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], in ''The Weakness of Inferiors''|<ref name="DEE">[[Dark Empire endnotes|''Dark Empire'' endnotes]]</ref>}}
'''''The Weakness of Inferiors''''' was the second volume of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] ''[[Dark Side Compendium]]''. ''The Weakness of Inferiors'' talked about the secrets of control&mdash;without violence&mdash;over the innocent, the ignorant, and "all inferiors". It discussed ways to properly control and persuade the weak using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Palpatine advocated a mix of fear and awe.<ref name="DEE" />

Palpatine was most proud of his teaching. All the content in ''The Weakness of Inferiors'' was developed by Palpatine himself, out of his own experience. Palpatine revealed this volume to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] without hesitation, convinced that young Skywalker was forever lost in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="DEE" />

This volume covered mainly four aspects:<ref name="DEE" />
*All power comes from outside the weak.<ref name="DEE" />
*The face of authority.<ref name="DEE" />
*The law of fear.<ref name="DEE" />
*The weak do not understand the Force.<ref name="DEE" />

It was estimated that reading the entire ''Weakness of Inferiors'' would require 96 hours.<ref name="DSS">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref> Luke Skywalker heard the content from Palpatine's own lips after his fall to the dark side.<ref name="DEE" />
